Reschedule this meeting?
This re-checks everyone's live availability, asks the AI for a fresh set of ranked times, and sends the customer new options. The current hold on the room is kept until they choose. The existing invitation is withdrawn, and the AI drafts a note with the revised options for your review before anything is sent.
Cancel this meeting?
This releases the room, withdraws the Outlook invitations, notifies operations, and writes a cancellation to the audit trail. A cancellation note to the customer is drafted for your review — nothing reaches them until you approve it.
